purpose: One person's employments as a framed group: company, role dates, titles; add, edit and remove.
namedChanges: The imports are the units': `company-search`, `remove-control`, `role-when`, `card-group`, `card-mode`, and the types of `employments-state`. The geo imports (`WorkLocationField`, `getPlace`, `usePlaceHitDetails`, `placeHitLine`) are gone.

`PlaceName` (source lines 100-132) is not taken: the read-only place name is the optional `renderPlaceName`; the Location box is the optional `renderWorkLocation`. Absent, no place is drawn, no Location box, and the stored place is carried unchanged by every role commit. An employment whose only content is a place is content only when `renderPlaceName` is given.
New props `find` and `vaultName` are handed to `company-search`; `recordsVaultId` is kept; new prop `vaultUnknown`.
A company and a role that are addresses are drawn as "A company" and "A role" (text, labels, the opened box); the source drew the stored text.
After a failed read (`editor.error`) the add box and "add employment" are withheld; the source drew the add box beside the error.
With `vaultUnknown` the card draws one sentence and is not empty; the source had no such state.
